title: Weather Organ
premise: A solitary browser instrument that turns pointer movement, local time, and optional microphone energy into a shifting atmospheric score.
independence_constraints: Do not explain or reference Mirror Cartographer.
Do not present research, project status, worker operations, or dashboards.
Do not include payments, conversion logic, lead capture, accounts, or product funnels.
Remain usable as a self-contained artwork when audio input is unavailable or denied.

creative_system.visual_language: slow orbital weather, paper-grain light, typographic pressure readings
creative_system.interaction: pointer position shapes pressure and wind; click toggles the instrument; keyboard arrows provide an equivalent path
creative_system.sound: procedural Web Audio drones activated only by explicit user input
creative_system.world_rule: the page behaves like a small climate rather than a document
